newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers continued at a standoff, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fair-good. Seller interest light.
Bids mostly 108.00; asking prices mostly 110.00. Last established market previous Thursday 109.00-110.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Confirmed - None Last Week - 34,300 Last Year - 2,100
For week - 2,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 39,500 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 5,700
